Conditions.Label: Economic Dominance
Conditions.Description: Control at least 35% of the world's total industrial capacity (civilian, military and naval factories combined).

Conditions.Label: Military Dominance
Conditions.Description: Capitulate 3 major powers (countries with 30 or more total factories).

Conditions.Label: Territorial Dominance
Conditions.Description: Hold at least 12% of all provinces in the world.

Conditions.Label: Global Leader
Conditions.Description: Finish the simulation holding the highest national score of any country in the world.

Conditions.Label: Survival
Conditions.Description: Remain independent and uncapitulated until the end date. The strongest country to finish intact wins.
